    if word.endswith('_id'):

    word = word.replace('_', ' ')
    word = re.sub(r"(?i)([a-z\d]*)", lambda m: m.group(1).lower(), word)
    word = re.sub(r"^\w", lambda m: m.group(0).upper(), word)
    return word
